intro: Latvia is a parliamentary republic and a member of NATO, the EU and the eurozone.

chapters.title: Saeima and president
text: The parliament, the Saeima, has 100 members and chooses the prime minister. Parliament also elects the president; Edgars Rinkēvičs, elected in 2023, became the first openly gay head of state of an EU country.

chapters.title: Symbols
text: The flag is dark red with a white stripe, one of the oldest flag designs in the world according to a medieval chronicle.

cardGroups.title: How power works
cardGroups.intro: Who chooses whom, and what each part of the system does.

steps.title: How a law is made
steps.intro: Most new laws follow these steps.

items.title: A bill is proposed
items.text: By the government, members or 10% of voters.

items.title: Readings
items.text: Usually two or three in the Saeima.

items.title: The President
items.text: Signs it, returns it, or delays it for a referendum.
